title: Update..Does Not toast even after Two Weeks! Waste of money.
text:
Update..Does Not toast even after Two Weeks! Waste of money.. Update--I have been using this toaster for maybe two weeks, and its failing fast!
It went from a 4 atar to a One star, could be even less!
It is now only getting the bread toasted or burned on the top and bottom of the
Bread.
Does Not toast in the middle of the bread, although it looks like some if the coils are on and Orange!
I usually toast a Full Grain Organic Bread, and sometimes Sour Dough, and raison.
I have never seen this happen with any toaster before. Not even with a inexpensive Black & Decker toaster oven,
That acually Toasted very even.
When I now push in the crumb drawer on the side It's not coming out far enough to grab it, and clean it.

Needless to say, I'm very disappointed with this toaster not to work after two weeks.
The toaster looks good, but the Quality is not there. A waste of money.

--------------------------------
Good looking moderen style 2 slice toaster.
There is a button to press on the front bottom for frozen bread that works good. A button to press for bagels, that will get the
Inside cut part toasty, and the round out side of the bagel is not crisp.
If you want to check your toast just lift up the push botton on the right side, and you can see if its too dark ,or light for
The type of bread your toasting.
When I just want the toast , This Russel Hobbs toasts pretty even toast on both sides.
When you press down to toast, the inside closes in on your toast so it does Not fall to one side and burn your toast,
A good feature.
This toaster is So light weight when I went to moveit back under the cabinet it fell over!
I can put 1 long piece of sliced french bread in.
On the side is the very narrow shallow crumb tray.
I don't have a problem with finger prints. I just use a slightly damp dish towel and wipe it down.

I thought this was going to take up allot less space then my heavy English chrome Rowlett toaster ( like the Dualit) measures 15 in wide x 7 in. Deep, But its also a 4 slice toaster.
This Russell Hobbs measures 15 in. Wide x 5 1/4 in Deep.2 slice toaster.
Not that much of a differents, and we realize we need a 4 toaster as we have allot of company and family.
Also the Hobbs is not any faster to toast with.
I'm not sure it is glass on the front!! I think its some type of plastic, but it looks good.

I'm giving this a 4 star for my toast coming out even. The modern look is sleek , and clean looking.
But This is so light weight it seems like a flimsy toaster, and I think its over price.
There is also a bread , croissant warmer for the top that I have not used yet, and not sure I will!.

product_metadata.title: Russell Hobbs TRL9300GYR 2-Slice Glass Accent Long Toaster, Silver & Stainless Steel
features: Long Toaster - The extended design occupies a narrow spot on your countertop, allowing for easy toasting of long cuts of bread and side-by-side toasting of smaller slices.
Removable Warming Rack - This wire rack attaches to the top of the toaster, allowing for easy warming of buns, pastries, and rolls. Remove for regular toasting.
Lift & Look - Monitor the progress of toasting without canceling the heating cycle.
Three Functions - The Bagel function toasts the cut side and warms the bottom side of bagels. The Frozen setting adjusts toasting to achieve results identical to fresh bread. Cancel ends toasting.
Variable Browning Control - Select the level of doneness you prefer, from 1 (light) to 6 (dark).
description: For years ordinary toasters have gone virtually unnoticed in the corners of kitchen counters. Those days are over with the Russell Hobbs 2-Slice Glass Accent Long Toaster. With its Extended design featuring silver glass accents, you’ll want to prominently display this elegant toaster. Luxurious, simple styling meets modern performance for Premium toasting performance. The variable browning control ranges from 1 (light) to 6 (dark) to satisfy all preferences. Choose the Bagel function for a perfectly toasted cut side with a warmed bottom side or the Frozen setting for fresh-like results. This toaster comes with a removable warming rack that quickly heats buns, pastries, and rolls. Plus, the removable crumb tray ensures easy cleanup.
